title: VPORT and VIEW ambient color-book name retained owners
mode: local fast implementation slice with generated controls
scope: Charge DXF VPORT and VIEW group-431 ambient color-book names to retained-text ownership
Preserve replacement, copy, assignment, and reset accounting
Exercise direct ASCII and Binary parsers without adding persistent fixtures

implementation.summary: DRW_Vport::ambientColorName and DRW_View::m_ambientColorName now use replaceDxfRetainedStringField with private per-field byte counters on their inherited DRW_TableEntry leases. Reset clears each counter before base reset; implicit copies and assignments preserve the string, counter, and shared lease.
implementation.layoutChange: One private retained-byte counter was added to each public DRW_Vport and DRW_View layout. Downstream consumers must rebuild; binary ABI compatibility is not claimed.

assessment.claim: The selected DXF VPORT and VIEW ambient color-book names are charged to the shared logical retained-byte budget. Exact-peak admission succeeds; one-byte-under replacement preserves the previous value and charge; copies retain the shared lease until final reset/destruction.
assessment.coverage: Generated ASCII/Binary direct-parser controls exercise VPORT and VIEW independently, including exact peak, reader teardown, under-cap preservation, copy/assignment, and final reset release.
assessment.limitations: Full TABLES callback publication and refusal, viewport/view graph closure, rendering, DWG string parsing, allocation capacity/RSS, public post-parse mutation, writer/projection copies, peer/native acceptance, and full-suite behavior are not covered.
